items.title: Independent dense coordinate restrictions preserve a fixed proportion of every natural tensor rank with exponentially high probability
items.author: Jop Briët and Davi Castro-Silva
items.difficulty_reason: Even with Talagrand's two-point inequality available, the task requires constructing a lower-mass event through a random ordered partition and a two-witness covering argument, then propagating the resulting exponential concentration through conditional restrictions in every tensor factor. This quantitative field-independent rank argument is beyond ordinary qualifying-exam probability or multilinear algebra; the entire authored concentration and factor iteration is retained.

items.title: Dense random coordinate restrictions preserve a fixed proportion of sufficiently large natural polynomial-map rank over every field
items.author: Jop Briët and Davi Castro-Silva
items.difficulty_reason: The polynomial restriction rank need not be subadditive as a Boolean set function, so the tensor concentration theorem does not supply this arbitrary-characteristic outcome. The complete authored degree induction passes to polynomial coefficient rings and extracts mixed monomials in two successive restrictions; a separate low-influence junta assignment and Lipschitz argument boosts positive probability to near certainty. These nonroutine local constructions remain after the precisely cited Margulis-Russo and Friedgut prerequisites, and are above ordinary qualifying-exam training.

items.title: Every real inflation factor greater than two is realized by an infinite compact-alphabet substitution whose words define Delone tilings
items.author: Dirk Frettlöh, Alexey Garber and Neil Mañibo
items.difficulty_reason: The task constructs and compactifies an infinite substitution alphabet while preserving continuity, then proves a uniform escape-letter growth estimate making its normalized operator quasicompact. Even after the precise named positive-operator and compact-alphabet background is allowed, the bounded power-series representation and explicit uniformly continuous positive eigenfunction must still realize every prescribed inflation factor. These nonroutine constructions exceed ordinary qualifying-exam symbolic dynamics or functional analysis; conservative H1 is used rather than relying on research-venue prestige.
